content: cPanel/Apache shared hosting: to parse .html as PHP, standard .htaccess directives are either 'AddHandler php-script .php .html .htm' or 'AddType application/x-httpd-php .php .htm .html' (exact handler name varies by host's PHP handler config: suPHP/CGI, mod_php/DSO, or PHP-FPM via lsapi/cgi wrapper each may register a different MIME/handler name). suPHP is deprecated industry-wide in favor of PHP-FPM; the exact working directive must be spike-tested per-host, not assumed.
